shortDescription: NetApp E-Series manage the storage system's server SSL certificates.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com:8443/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: certificates
options.description: Unordered list of all server certificate files which include PEM and DER encoded certificates as well as private keys. When I(certificates) is not defined then a self-signed certificate will be expected.

options.name: controller
options.description: The controller that owns the port you want to configure. Controller names are represented alphabetically, with the first controller as A, the second as B, and so on. Current hardware models have either 1 or 2 available controllers, but that is not a guaranteed hard limitation and could change in the future. I(controller) must be specified unless managing SANtricity Web Services Proxy (ie I(ssid="proxy"))

options.name: passphrase
options.description: Passphrase for PEM encoded private key encryption. If I(passphrase) is not supplied then Ansible will prompt for private key certificate.

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.
